## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Which Hyundai cars are available in Nizamabad?**
A: Prakash Hyundai stocks the full 2025–26 Hyundai lineup — Grand i10 NIOS, Aura, i20, i20 N Line, Exter, Venue, Venue N Line, Creta, Creta N Line, Verna, Alcazar, and Ioniq 5.

**Q: What is the on-road price of Hyundai Creta in Nizamabad?**
A: The Hyundai Creta on-road price in Nizamabad starts from approximately ₹12.5 lakh (base petrol) to ₹22 lakh (top diesel variant). Contact Prakash Hyundai at 9052110303 for the exact current price with all offers.

**Q: Does Prakash Hyundai offer home test drives?**
A: Yes. Free doorstep test drives are available across Nizamabad city and surrounding areas including Armoor, Bodhan, Banswada, and Kamareddy. WhatsApp 9052110303 to book.

**Q: What EMI options are available on Hyundai cars in Nizamabad?**
A: Prakash Hyundai offers car loans through SBI, HDFC, Axis, ICICI, and other banks. EMI starts from ₹8,500/month on the Exter. Zero down payment schemes are available. Call 9052110303 for an EMI quote.

**Q: Where is Prakash Hyundai's main showroom in Nizamabad?**
A: The main showroom is at Hyderabad Road, Dichpally, Nizamabad, Telangana 503001 — near Dichpally, on the Hyderabad highway.

**Q: How many showrooms does Prakash Hyundai have?**
A: 9 showrooms — Nizamabad (main), Armoor, Bodhan, Banswada, Kamareddy, Adilabad, Mancheriyal, Nirmal, and Bhainsa.

**Q: Is Prakash Hyundai an authorized dealer?**
A: Yes. Prakash Hyundai is an authorized Hyundai Motor India dealership, operating since 2008 with full sales, service, and spare parts authorization.
